Name: Alchemist's Valley
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
[size=3]The mod adds 45 new potions to shops, each with different stats and gift tastes. You can also use a cauldron to make potions! I tried to make everything as unique as I could.

How do I make potions? Buy the cauldron recipe from Clint and read the recipes list.

[size=3]To make more Ravenous Soul you need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/172]Recatch Legendary Fish[/url].

You can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url] on the cauldron to see all recipes in game. This mod will be updated to content patcher in 1.6

This is my first item mod, so please let me know if you come across any bugs. Don't hesitate to give me suggestions regarding the balance, names, recipes, potions, or anything else.
